import bpy
exec("
# Use low-contrast, non-directional foliage colour. A metre-scale planar UV
# made the former three-wave recipe read as vertical ribbing on crowns.
yy,xx=np.mgrid[0:512,0:512].astype(float)/512
variation=.006*np.sin(math.tau*(xx+yy)+.8*np.sin(math.tau*yy))+.005*np.cos(math.tau*(xx-yy))+.004*np.sin(math.tau*(xx*2+yy))
for i,h in enumerate(['477633','6b8e3b','315e32']):
    material=bpy.data.materials['Ref_D19_Foliage'+str(i)]
    node=next(n for n in material.node_tree.nodes if n.type=='TEX_IMAGE')
    im=node.image
    if im.packed_file:im.unpack(method='REMOVE')
    arr=np.ones((512,512,4));col=np.array([int(h[k:k+2],16)/255 for k in (0,2,4)])
    arr[:,:,:3]=col[None,None,:]*(1+variation[:,:,None])
    im.pixels.foreach_set(arr.astype(np.float32).ravel());im.save();im.pack()
    material.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF').inputs['Specular IOR Level'].default_value=.12
export_collection('Reference_Foliage','foliage.glb')
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(ROOT/'source/reference_harbor_mcp.blend'))
print('FOLIAGE_SURFACE_FINISHED')
",bpy.app.driver_namespace['detail19'])
